trigger_or_action.reason: Attacker calls vault.redeem(shares, attackerAddress, victimAddress) where victim has self-allowance but no allowance to attacker.

direct_effect.reason: Victim's shares are burned and underlying assets transferred to attacker, enabling theft.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected ERC4626 allowance check between caller and owner is ignored; only self-allowance is checked, violating authorization relation.

summary: Report fragments provide concrete affected component, trigger, direct effect, and authorization safety relation, sufficient for P/I/V derivation.
